status: PROOF OF CONCEPT, option B (D36, 11 November 2026): the links of the provisional, investigator-led map (configs/expert_map_provisional.json, D25) between the six domains of option B, taken unchanged, before any 6-domain result on PPMI was seen. Used with --fixed-map: Step 1 adds no links.
format: links are [from, to] pairs of domain names, read as: 'from' this year directly changes 'to' next year. Every domain also affects itself (own rates, always in the support). With --fixed-map, H-P's support is exactly these links plus the six own rates: 14 entries, so H-P has (2 - 1) x (14 - 1) = 13 degrees of freedom.
